title: Clear Aligners vs Braces: Which Is Right for You?
description: Clear aligners vs metal and ceramic braces compared for teens and adults: effectiveness, comfort, appearance, treatment time, cost factors and insurance.
h1: Clear aligners vs braces: which is right for you?
intro: Both clear aligners and braces can straighten teeth. The right choice depends on your bite, your lifestyle and how disciplined you will be.

image.alt: Dental model with metal braces on the teeth

cardText: Clear aligners vs metal and ceramic braces compared for teens and adults: effectiveness, comfort, appearance, treatment time, cost factors and insurance.

sections.html: Braces use brackets bonded to the teeth and wires adjusted by the orthodontist. Options include metal, ceramic (tooth-colored) and lingual braces placed behind the teeth. Clear aligners are a series of removable plastic trays, each moving teeth slightly, usually worn for most of the day.

AlignersBraces
AppearanceNearly invisibleMore visible
EatingRemove to eat; no food restrictionsAvoid hard and sticky foods
CleaningBrush and floss normallyTakes more effort
ComplianceResults depend on wear timeAlways working
Complex casesIncreasingly possible, depends on caseHandles the widest range

Cost depends on case complexity and treatment length more than on the appliance. Dental plans with orthodontic benefits may cover part of either, often up to a lifetime maximum, and HSA/FSA funds can be used. faqs.q: Are clear aligners as effective as braces?
faqs.a: For many mild to moderate cases, yes, when worn as prescribed and planned by an experienced provider. Complex bites may be better treated with braces.
